mitigation_playbook.title: Evidence-Linked Historical Mitigation Playbook
mitigation_playbook.disclaimer: Historical evidence only. Final operational action remains subject to approved OIL procedures and engineer judgment.

steps.title: Detect Loss / Reduced Returns
steps.action: Continuously monitor active pit levels and flow-out paddle sensor for sudden delta > 2 m³/hr or volume drop > 3 bbls.
steps.precaution: Conduct immediate 10-minute flow check with pumps off to differentiate micro-fracture ballooning from matrix loss.

steps.title: Apply Loss-Control Treatment
steps.action: Spot pre-mixed 35–45 bbl multi-modal LCM pill (coarse resilient graphitic carbon + medium CaCO3 nut-plug @ 35 ppb) across the loss interval.
steps.precaution: Pull bit minimum 30m above loss zone prior to soaking to prevent differential sticking.

steps.title: Monitor Circulation and Returns
steps.action: Allow pill to soak for 4 to 6 hours under hydrostatic column; resume slow-rate staged circulation at 40–50% nominal GPM.
steps.precaution: Cap Equivalent Circulating Density (ECD) at 10.4 ppg; restrict surge velocities during pipe movement.

steps.title: Escalate According to Approved Drilling Procedure if Losses Persist
steps.action: If full returns are not established after secondary pill soak, stage thixotropic bentonite-diesel oil (BDOC) plug or balanced cement squeeze plug.
steps.precaution: Notify Drilling Superintendent and verify wellbore casing burst margin before pressure testing squeeze.
